- yay-packages.list: Central registry of yay packages (8 packages)

- Refactored 9 install scripts to use centralized installers
- Fixed copy-paste errors in comments (install-lsof.sh, install-yazi.sh, install-ripgrep.sh)

- DRY principle: Single source of truth for package installation logic
- Easier maintenance: Update installation behavior in one place
- Consistent error handling and package existence checks
- Centralized package management via list files
- Proper handling of package/binary name mismatches
